description: This file defines the Normal distribution functions (distribution and inverse) for statistical calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including methods for probability density function, cumulative distribution function, and inverse cumulative distribution.

classes.name: Normal
classes.description: Class providing methods for normal distribution calculations, including probability density, cumulative distribution, and inverse functions.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the normal distribution (PDF or CDF) for a given value, mean, and standard deviation.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the normal distribution (quantile function) for a given probability, mean, and standard deviation.

methods.name: inverseNcdf
methods.description: Private method implementing the inverse normal cumulative distribution function approximation by Peter J. Acklam.
